verdict.rationale: YYLO Skills is a versioned skills and plugin pack that host agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Pi install and consume. Acting as an MCP client that connects to external MCP servers is the host agent's role, not a capability of a skills bundle, so this axis is a category error. Nothing in the evidence shows the pack itself connecting to or registering MCP servers, so the exception does not apply.
